disclosureQuote: We are utilising ElevenLabs’ text-to-speech tool, to generate some voice-over elements within Train Sim World 7. This is utilised in features such as training modules, as well as platform and onboard train announcements. All scripts and content are written by Dovetail Games staff, with ElevenLabs used to generate the audio in these instances.
summary: 铁路模拟系列新作，2026 年 9 月 15 日上市。开发者披露用 ElevenLabs 文字转语音生成部分配音（教学模块、站台与车内播报），并强调所有脚本与内容由 Dovetail 员工撰写。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Dovetail Games，发行商 Dovetail Games - TSW）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 282），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 2 篇原始来源（HowMuchAI 逐部件拆解本作披露的分析页、The Big Bois 本作评测中记录商店披露的段落），两者都是对商店披露的转录或转述，不构成独立核实。其余结果为本作商店页、宣传片视频、Key 商城与数据聚合页。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。语音部分披露用“some”限定，未给出数量占比；这些语音素材是否为运行时生成，商店页未说明，ingame 按“披露未说明”处理。
description: 驾驶与经营铁路的模拟作品，主打轻松跑线与虚拟司机生涯。

english.summary: The latest entry in Dovetail's train simulation series, released on Sep 15, 2026. The developer states that ElevenLabs text-to-speech generates some voice-over elements, used in training modules and platform and onboard announcements, while all scripts and content are written by Dovetail staff.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Dovetail Games, publisher Dovetail Games - TSW) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 282); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 2 raw source(s) were read: a HowMuchAI page that breaks the disclosure down part by part and a The Big Bois review that records the store disclosure. Both reproduce or retell the store text and are not independent verification. The remaining results were the store page, a trailer video, a key shop and a data aggregator. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. The disclosure hedges the amount with the word some and does not say whether any speech is generated at run time, so the in-game area is recorded as not addressed.
